reasons: Both are two sentences, keep the administrator's rotation, the re-login and the 401, and neither adds any remark about when to send or deliver a message. A still leaves the last clause passive and actorless ("их запросы отклоняются") and repeats "ротация" twice, while B gives every clause an actor and an active verb ("сервер отклонит их запросы"), which is exactly what the de-passivising requirement asks and is an implied actor rather than a new fact. The difference is one clause, so the margin is small.
